Q6097.reason: Under modern law, 'heirs of his body' creates a fee tail which terminates at death if no heirs exist, leaving the grantor with a reversion.

Q5137.reason: An expert witness cannot testify to an opinion based on facts (x-rays) that have not been introduced into evidence first.

Q5526.reason: Burglary requires unlawful entry with intent to commit a felony or theft; entering to threaten someone for money owed satisfies the intent requirement even without actual theft.
